charter.mission: We hold the network to its obligation to the region: care that people can get to, that is safe, and that the network can still afford to provide next year.
charter.process: We meet quarterly against the strategic plan, approve capital, and take one report from each of Access, Clinical, Revenue Cycle and Operations.

charter.mission: We are accountable for whether a person in this region can get an appointment when they need one, by phone or on their own.
charter.process: Referral and call volume come in daily; we manage template capacity across clinics weekly with Clinic Operations and read out third-next-available monthly.

charter.mission: We own the quality and safety of the care delivered, and the clinical standards every site works to.
charter.process: Quality and safety data are reviewed monthly with each service line; standards are set once and then audited, not renegotiated per clinic.

charter.mission: We make sure the care the network gives is the care the network gets paid for, without surprising the patient.
charter.process: Claims go out daily and denials come back; we work a weekly denial queue with Coding and Billing IT and report days-in-AR monthly.

charter.mission: We keep the network staffed with people who want to stay, because agency cover is the most expensive way to run a clinic.
charter.process: A rolling hiring plan runs against the staffing model; nursing vacancy and turnover are read out monthly with Workforce Planning.

charter.mission: We run the buildings, the supplies and the money so that clinical teams only have to think about patients.
charter.process: Site metrics are reviewed weekly and the budget monthly; anything that needs capital goes to the board with a payback period attached.
